title: Predicting Murder
summary: A voodoo priestess seemingly predicts her own murder as she is found murdered in a classroom. The headmaster is suspected but has a solid alibi.
method: There was no murder; the victim committed suicide to frame the headmaster because she strongly believed that he killed her daughter. The victim poisoned the rum and left two cups out to frame the headmaster. The body of the victim's daughter was found to be the skeleton in the classroom. The killer had purchased lime under the guise of house construction to use for dissolving the body.
motive: He killed his wife 15 years ago after she revealed her affair with the local priest.
